data.body: **[P1] Keep suspended CONTEXT operations non-recording until terminal completion.** This ends every recording entry at each invocation boundary, but `on_user_function_start()` still creates CONTEXT operation spans with the deterministic operation ID. A child context that waits therefore exports an unfinished span on the PENDING invocation, then replay exports another span with the same trace/span ID when the context completes; collectors can overwrite or reject the authoritative terminal span. Use a non-recording placeholder for CONTEXT operations too, materialize it only in `on_operation_end()`, and add a suspend/replay child-context test asserting exactly one terminal span.
